text:
mia_support: Hey team — HexaFoods reports they've been billed twice for the same Dedicated subscription during the last renewal window. One invoice came via PO and one as a card charge. Customer needs the card charge reversed and a credit note so their AP can match to PO. Invoice IDs: INV-2026-1147 (PO), INV-2026-1148 (card). PO: PO-772. VAT looks doubled in their accounting run. :grimacing:
jordan_billing: Thanks @mia_support. Can you paste the payment intent / charge IDs and the Stripe webhook events if available? I'll need permission to issue a refund and create a credit note in finance system.
omar_payments: Payment IDs: `pi_3K7xZ9LwQ` -> charge `ch_1L9aB2MxY`. I see a successful charge on 2026-11-02 15:12 UTC for €12,000 and a separate invoice created from PO for €10,000 + VAT. Looks like our tax calculation differed between PO invoice and card invoice.
priya_finance: VAT discrepancy flagged — PO-based invoice shows VAT 20% on net €10,000 => €12,000 total. Card invoice shows €12,000 net and VAT applied again => customer paid €14,400 effectively. We need to issue a refund for the card charge amount of €2,400 (the duplicated VAT) plus reconcile gross duplication.
mia_support: HexaFoods pasted screenshots of bank statement showing two debits and the PO number on their AP side, they're pretty urgent — mention: "need vendor credit note by EOD".
jordan_billing: I can create a credit note against INV-2026-1148 and submit refund for the card charge once Payments confirms. @omar_payments can you confirm refund is allowed and whether the payment is still capturable or already settled?
omar_payments: Charge `ch_1L9aB2MxY` is settled (capture done). We can refund fully. I've queued a refund with Stripe: `re_1M2bC3` — status: pending (started 2026-11-04 09:22 UTC). However our refund webhook didn't post back to the invoice service due to a 502 from /webhooks/stripe on that retry window.
sam_sre: @omar_payments I see a few 502 spikes in the logs around that time. I restarted the webhook worker and re-played failed events using our internal replay tool. Should be delivered now. Re-run:```
# replay command
./tools/event-replay --source stripe --id re_1M2bC3 --env prod
```
priya_finance: Once the refund webhook lands, we need a PDF credit note with a link to the original PO and reference to reconciled invoice. Also update tax reason code `VAT_DUPLICATE_CHARGE`. Can billing generate the credit note?
jordan_billing: Yep will generate CN-2026-045 referencing INV-2026-1148 and link PO-772. Will mark as "refund issued" once Stripe confirms.
mia_support: HexaFoods pasted screenshots of bank statement showing two debits and the PO number on their AP side, they're pretty urgent — mention: "need vendor credit note by EOD".
priya_finance: Once the refund webhook lands, we need a PDF credit note with a link to the original PO and reference to reconciled invoice. Also update tax reason code `VAT_DUPLICATE_CHARGE`. Can billing generate the credit note?
jordan_billing: Yep will generate CN-2026-045 referencing INV-2026-1148 and link PO-772. Will mark as "refund issued" once Stripe confirms.
mia_support: HexaFoods pasted screenshots of bank statement showing two debits and the PO number on their AP side, they're pretty urgent — mention: "need vendor credit note by EOD".
omar_payments: Stripe ETA for refund settlement back to card 5-10 business days, but we'll mark the invoice as credited in our system immediately so their AP can accept the credit note for reconciliation. Refund status will be propagated.
jordan_billing: Created credit note CN-2026-045 (draft) — attaching link to invoice UI: https://console.redwood.ai/billing/invoices/INV-2026-1148 :link: Will finalize once webhook confirms refund.
sam_sre: Confirmed webhook replay succeeded — invoice service returned 200. Event id: evt_9N8c7.
invoice-bot: New invoice created INV-2026-1147 (PO: PO-772) amount: €12,000 VAT: 20% created 2026-11-02 15:12 UTC.
priya_finance: After credit note applied, AP wants a single final document showing net owed 0. Please also generate a combined PDF including CN and original PO reference. That's a Finance policy for PO customers.
jordan_billing: Will export combined PDF and upload to HexaFoods's tenant. I'll also add internal note: "Tax mismatch root cause: PO invoice populated taxable base incorrectly (should be €10,000 net). Fix queued for invoice generator template."
mia_support: Thanks all — I'll reply to HexaFoods: "We've issued a credit note (CN-2026-045) and initiated refund re_1M2bC3; credit note available in tenant. Refund settlement to card 5-10 biz days, but your AP can reconcile immediately against CN." :thumbsup:
priya_finance: After close, please ping me with the PDF and confirm ledger entries. I'll sign off for accounting closure.
jordan_billing: Will do. Marking thread resolved after CN published and webhook confirmed. :white_check_mark:
